sections.theory:
Cardiac Diseases

Like other diseases, heart diseases too have always been connected with human life, but in the present age the rate of heart diseases in humans adopting a modern but unnatural way of life is as high today as perhaps never before in human history. In the following lines the causes and symptoms of heart diseases are being mentioned in detail.

Important causes

Obesity and eating more than needed.

Hereditary causes.

Congenital defects.

Fat forming a layer on the inner surface of the arteries and creating an obstruction in the passage of blood.

Cholesterol increasing in the blood and thickening it.

High blood pressure (High-B.P).

Use of tobacco.

Use of alcohol and other intoxicants.

Mental pressure and nervous tension.

Social injustice and the economic and psychological problems arising from it too are counted as an important cause of heart diseases.
